---
name: Suggest a mentor or source / 推荐导师与资料
about: Help build your mentor library with attributable public material / 一起补充可核对的人生导师
title: "[Mentor] "
---

## Person and practical topic / 人物与实际问题

Who would you like to add or improve, and what can their public material help people think about?
你想新增或完善谁？相关资料能帮助分析什么问题？

## Original public sources / 一手公开来源

Add original URLs, publisher/author, dates when known, and precise pages, headings or timestamps. A short excerpt is enough; do not paste full articles, books or transcripts.
请附原始链接、发布者／作者、已知日期与页码、标题或时间戳。短摘录即可，不粘贴整篇文章、书籍或采访。

## Attribution, context and limits / 归属、上下文与边界

Who is actually speaking? What conditions, counterexamples or changes of mind matter?
实际说话人是谁？有哪些条件、反例或观点变化需要保留？

## What you checked / 已核对与待核对

Describe text/caption/audio checks, AI assistance, and anything still unknown. A suggestion does not imply verified evidence.
说明核对的是文字、字幕还是音频，是否使用 AI 辅助，以及尚不确定的部分。推荐资料不等于已核验证据。

Use public or explicitly authorized material. Keep private conversations, credentials and personal data out of this public issue.
仅使用公开或明确授权的材料；不要提交私人对话、凭据或个人隐私。
